offering_description.value: Sells vacation ownership interests (timeshare points and weeks) at branded resorts to leisure consumers, and operates resorts, exchange and rental programs. It also finances purchases and manages resorts and owner associations for fees under licensed Marriott, Hyatt, Sheraton, Westin and other brands.

primary_products.value: vacation ownership interests; points-based vacation club memberships; fractional and residential ownership; consumer financing

primary_services.value: resort management; owner association management; vacation exchange programs; vacation rentals; consumer loan servicing

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure travelers and families buying timeshare ownership, renting stays, or using exchange programs; B2B: resort owner associations paying management fees

end_markets.value: leisure travel; hospitality; vacation ownership; resort real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: sale of vacation ownership interests to consumers; service fees: resort and owner association management, exchange and rental fees, club dues; interest or premiums: interest income on financing of vacation ownership purchases; licensing or royalties: brand license fees paid out are costs, some fees from brand arrangements
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; interest or premiums; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: develops, owns and operates resorts, buying land and construction, serving vacation owners and guests; brand owner: markets vacation clubs using licensed hotel brands to consumers; financial intermediary: originates and services timeshare loans to purchasers; service provider: manages resorts and exchange programs for owners and associations
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; brand owner; financial intermediary; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Resorts mainly in the US, Caribbean, Mexico, Europe and Asia Pacific, exchange network worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: timeshare sales, financing, resort management, exchange and rental

distribution_channels.value: own locations: sales centers at resorts and off-site sales offices; direct sales: telemarketing and marketing to existing owners and tour guests; online: web and app bookings for rentals and exchanges

regulatory_exposure.value: high: timeshare sales and lending licensed and regulated by state real estate and consumer protection laws, CFPB, and foreign rules

notes: Licensing/royalty entry is uncertain; brand fees are mostly paid out by the company.
